title: Pure Superheavy Samurai
summary: Pure Superheavy Samurai Steadfast strategy running exclusively monsters and zero Spells or Traps to satisfy the strict 'no Spells/Traps in GY' requirement. The deck attacks directly from Defense Position using towering DEF stats, executing rapid Pendulum setups and Synchro climbs into defensive powerhouses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Superheavy Samurai Motorbike discards itself from hand to search any Superheavy Samurai monster from your Deck, and targets a Superheavy Samurai on field to increase its Level by 2.

Superheavy Samurai Prodigy Wakaushi places a Superheavy Samurai Pendulum Monster from Deck to your opposite Pendulum Zone then Special Summons itself, and summons a Superheavy Samurai from hand or Deck.
Superheavy Samurai Monk Big Benkei sends Big Benkei from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand, and searches a Superheavy Samurai Soul monster from your Deck while in the Pendulum Zone.
Superheavy Samurai Soulpiercer adds any Superheavy Samurai monster from your Deck to your hand when sent from the field to the GY, functioning without a once-per-turn restriction.

summary.title: Opening: Prodigy Wakaushi
steps: Activate Superheavy Samurai Prodigy Wakaushi in your Pendulum Zone.
Activate Wakaushi's Pendulum effect: place Superheavy Samurai Monk Big Benkei in your opposite Pendulum Zone and Special Summon Wakaushi.
Activate Monk Big Benkei's Pendulum effect to search Superheavy Samurai Soulpiercer from your Deck.
Normal Summon Soulpiercer, then Synchro Summon Superheavy Samurai Commander Shanawo.
Trigger Soulpiercer's GY effect to search Superheavy Samurai Soulpeacemaker, then climb into Superheavy Samurai Brave Masurawo.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Superheavy Samurai Brave Masurawo is a Level 12 Synchro with 4000 DEF that attacks in Defense Position, protects other Superheavy Samurai cards from destruction by destroying an equipped card instead, and draws cards until you hold 3 cards whenever your opponent activates a Spell or Trap.

Superheavy Samurai Commander Shanawo attacks in Defense Position, revives a Superheavy Samurai from the GY on summon, and places itself in the Pendulum Zone while Special Summoning a face-up Pendulum from your Extra Deck.
Superheavy Samurai Big Benkei allows all Superheavy Samurai monsters you control to attack while in face-up Defense Position, applying their DEF for damage calculation.
Superheavy Samurai Stealthy Special Summons itself from hand with an empty Spell/Trap GY, and Sets a Spell or Trap from your opponent's GY to your field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: This pure Steadfast build runs zero Spells and Traps in the Main Deck, ensuring every single Superheavy Samurai requirement is permanently met.
Superheavy Samurai Soulgaia Booster equips to a Superheavy Samurai to treat it as a Tuner, and Special Summons itself from the Spell and Trap Zone.
Superheavy Samurai Soulpeacemaker equips to a Superheavy Samurai and tributes it to Special Summon any Superheavy Samurai from your Deck.
Superheavy Samurai Flutist tributes itself from hand to Special Summon a Superheavy Samurai from hand, and banishes from GY to negate an opponent's targeting effect.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Superheavy Samurai Scarecrow is Forbidden in the TCG, and Infinite Impermanence is excluded because placing a Trap in the GY turns off all Superheavy Samurai effects.

exclude.Infinite Impermanence: A Trap in the GY switches off the Superheavy Samurai effects.
